item.title: Trump suggests renaming Strait of Hormuz after himself
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday proposed renaming the Strait of Hormuz to the "Trump Strait," a key oil shipping route.

item.title: Canada awards millions in contracts to Iran VP's son
Soros-linked paper in Michigan mislabels El-Sayed as veteran
item.description: A newspaper funded by George Soros incorrectly called Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed a veteran in a statewide headline.

item.title: Cruz warns China fueling AI data center opposition
item.description: Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX) says China is helping drive resistance to AI data centers in the U.S., citing Beijing's influence.
